fields.name: timestamp
fields.label: Timestamp
fields.description: UTC timestamp of the request start time (ISO 8601 with timezone).

fields.name: ts_ms
fields.label: Timestamp (ms)
fields.description: Request start time in milliseconds since the Unix epoch. Routes rows into windows and orders window files.

fields.name: ip
fields.label: Client IP
fields.description: Client IP address. Captured at the real edge via x-fos-edge-data header; falls back to client.ip for requests answered before capture ran (e.g. redirects).

fields.name: status
fields.label: Response Status
fields.description: HTTP response status code (e.g. 200, 404, 503).

fields.name: elapsed
fields.label: Elapsed Time (µs)
fields.description: Total request processing time in microseconds.

fields.name: cache
fields.label: Cache State
fields.description: Fastly cache state: HIT, MISS, PASS, SYNTH, etc.

fields.name: resp_bytes
fields.label: Response Bytes
fields.description: Bytes delivered to the client in the response body.

fields.name: host
fields.label: Host
fields.description: HTTP Host header (domain name) captured at the true client edge before any rewrites.

fields.name: url
fields.label: URL
fields.description: Request URL path and query string. Average ~30 bytes; varies widely.

fields.name: method
fields.label: HTTP Method
fields.description: Request method: GET, POST, HEAD, PUT, DELETE, etc.

fields.name: proto
fields.label: HTTP Version
fields.description: HTTP protocol version: 1.0, 1.1, 2.0, or 3.0.

fields.name: ua
fields.label: User-Agent
fields.description: Client browser or bot identifier. Largest single field — bots inflate this significantly.
fields.note: Largest single field — bots tend to have verbose user-agents.

fields.name: referer
fields.label: Referer
fields.description: Referring URL. Often empty; useful for traffic source analysis.

fields.name: req_bytes
fields.label: Request Body Size
fields.description: Request body size in bytes from Content-Length header. Zero for GET/HEAD or any request without Content-Length.

fields.name: req_header_bytes
fields.label: Request Header Size
fields.description: Total bytes in the request headers. Large values are an injection or WAF bypass signal.

fields.name: resp_header_content_encoding
fields.label: Response Content-Encoding
fields.description: Content-Encoding of the response served to the client (gzip / br / zstd, or empty when the response was sent uncompressed). Low-cardinality. Read directly from the final response at log time — no edge capture needed.

fields.name: ttl
fields.label: Object TTL
fields.description: Time-to-live assigned by origin headers. Null when object is not cacheable.

fields.name: age
fields.label: Object Age
fields.description: How long the object has been in the Fastly cache (seconds).

fields.name: hits
fields.label: Object Hit Count
fields.description: Number of times this cached object has been served.

fields.name: digest
fields.label: Content Digest
fields.description: Content hash for exact object identity. Required for Cache Pressure Analysis.
fields.note: Required for Cache Pressure Analysis (eviction detection).

fields.name: pop
fields.label: Edge PoP
fields.description: Fastly Point of Presence code (e.g. JFK, LHR, SYD).

fields.name: backend
fields.label: Backend
fields.description: Origin backend name as configured in Fastly.

fields.name: edge
fields.label: Edge Hit
fields.description: True when the request hit the real edge (not a shield or restart).

fields.name: ttfb
fields.label: Time to First Byte (s)
fields.description: Seconds from request receipt to first byte of response from origin. Subtract from elapsed to isolate Fastly processing time.

fields.name: server_region
fields.label: Server Region
fields.description: Fastly billing region of the serving PoP (e.g. NA, EU, APAC). Captured at edge for accurate attribution through shields.

fields.name: is_ipv6
fields.label: IPv6
fields.description: True when the client connected over IPv6. IPv6 clients can have different routing and latency profiles.

fields.name: conn_requests
fields.label: Conn. Request Count
fields.description: Number of requests made on this TCP/QUIC connection. High values indicate HTTP/2 keep-alive multiplexing.

fields.name: tls
fields.label: TLS Version
fields.description: TLS protocol version as a float: 1.2 or 1.3.

fields.name: country
fields.label: Country
fields.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code (e.g. US, DE, JP). Enables world map.

fields.name: city
fields.label: City
fields.description: City name from Fastly geo-IP. Variable length.

fields.name: region
fields.label: Region
fields.description: ISO 3166-2 region/state/province code.

fields.name: lat
fields.label: Latitude
fields.description: Client latitude (-90 to 90). Null for unresolvable IPs.

fields.name: lon
fields.label: Longitude
fields.description: Client longitude (-180 to 180). Null for unresolvable IPs.

fields.name: metro
fields.label: Metro Code
fields.description: US DMA metro area code (e.g. 501 = New York City). Empty for non-US.

fields.name: asn
fields.label: ASN
fields.description: Client Autonomous System Number (ISP identity). Enables ASN-level analysis.

fields.name: tcp_rtt
fields.label: TCP RTT (µs)
fields.description: TCP round-trip time in microseconds at the Fastly edge.

fields.name: transport
fields.label: Transport Protocol
fields.description: Transport protocol: 'tcp' or 'quic'. Low-cardinality; essentially free in Parquet.

fields.name: ploss
fields.label: Packet Loss
fields.description: Packet loss fraction (0.0–1.0). Direct indicator of network congestion.

fields.name: rtt_min
fields.label: Minimum RTT (µs)
fields.description: Minimum RTT seen on this TCP connection (geography baseline). Delta from tcp_rtt isolates congestion.

fields.name: rtt_var
fields.label: RTT Variance / Jitter (µs)
fields.description: RTT variance in microseconds. Jitter causes streaming buffer stalls more than raw latency.

fields.name: retrans
fields.label: TCP Retransmissions
fields.description: TCP retransmission delta since previous sample. Direct congestion signal.

fields.name: bw
fields.label: Bandwidth Estimate
fields.description: Fastly's estimated bandwidth for this connection (bytes/sec or bits/sec — see note). Only applicable for QUIC; TCP connections should use delivery_rate instead.

fields.name: c_speed
fields.label: Connection Speed Class
fields.description: Geo-IP speed classification: broadband, cable, dsl, mobile, satellite, dialup. Low-cardinality.

fields.name: c_type
fields.label: Connection Type
fields.description: Geo-IP connection type: residential, commercial, cellular, corporate. Low-cardinality.

fields.name: delivery_rate
fields.label: TCP Delivery Rate
fields.description: Actual TCP delivery rate in bytes/sec measured by the kernel. More reliable than bandwidth estimate for TCP connections.

fields.name: data_segs_out
fields.label: TCP Data Segments Out
fields.description: Total TCP data segments sent on this connection. Enables retransmit ratio: retrans / data_segs_out.

fields.name: ja3
fields.label: JA3 Fingerprint
fields.description: MD5 TLS client fingerprint. Older standard; widely supported. 41 bytes avg.

fields.name: ja4
fields.label: JA4 Fingerprint
fields.description: Newer, richer TLS fingerprint standard. 43 bytes avg.

fields.name: tls_ciphers_sha
fields.label: TLS Cipher Suite SHA
fields.description: SHA fingerprint of the client's offered cipher suite list. Evasion-resistant complement to JA3/JA4 for bot farm detection.

fields.name: p_type
fields.label: Proxy Type
fields.description: Anonymizing proxy type: VPN, Tor, DCH (data center), etc.

fields.name: p_desc
fields.label: Proxy Description
fields.description: Anonymizing proxy provider name.

fields.name: waf
fields.label: WAF Executed
fields.description: Whether NGWAF inspected this request (waf.inspection.verdict is set). NGWAF runs only on cache misses and passes, so hits are false.

fields.name: waf_resp
fields.label: WAF Agent Response
fields.description: NGWAF decision code: waf.inspection.agentresponse when set, else the response status for a block verdict or 200 for allow (the edge integration leaves agentresponse 0); null when uninspected.

fields.name: waf_ms
fields.label: WAF Latency (ms)
fields.description: NGWAF inspection decision time in ms (waf.inspection.decision_ms); null when uninspected.

fields.name: waf_sig
fields.label: WAF Signal Tags
fields.description: NGWAF signal tags from waf.inspection.tags (e.g. SQLI, XSS, TRAVERSAL).

fields.name: waf_req_id
fields.label: WAF Request ID
fields.description: NGWAF request correlation ID header, when the edge integration sets one.

fields.name: q_rtt
fields.label: QUIC Smoothed RTT (µs)
fields.description: QUIC smoothed RTT in microseconds. Null for TCP connections.

fields.name: q_rtt_var
fields.label: QUIC RTT Variance (µs)
fields.description: QUIC RTT variance in microseconds. Null for TCP connections.

fields.name: q_lost
fields.label: QUIC Packets Lost
fields.description: QUIC packets lost counter. Null for TCP connections.

fields.name: q_cwnd
fields.label: QUIC Congestion Window
fields.description: QUIC congestion window size. Null for TCP connections.

fields.name: ottfb
fields.label: Origin TTFB (µs)
fields.description: µs from fetch start to first byte of origin/shield response headers. Null on HITs.

fields.name: ottlb
fields.label: Origin TTLB (µs)
fields.description: µs from fetch start to full response body received. Null on HITs.

fields.name: oconnect_ms
fields.label: Origin Connect (ms)
fields.description: Milliseconds to establish the connection (TCP + TLS handshake) to origin/shield, from beresp.handshake_time_to_origin_ms. Distinct from ottfb (first byte). Null on HITs and on failed fetches that never connected — connection timeouts land in vcl_error, where beresp (and therefore the handshake timing) is unavailable.

fields.name: ost
fields.label: Origin Status
fields.description: HTTP status returned by origin or shield. Null on HITs.

fields.name: obytes
fields.label: Origin Bytes
fields.description: Bytes written in the response (resp.bytes_written). Null on HITs. Same variable as resp_bytes but null-on-HIT makes it queryable as 'total bytes fetched from origin'.

fields.name: oip
fields.label: Origin IP
fields.description: IP address of the backend server that handled the fetch. Null on HITs.

fields.name: oretries
fields.label: Origin Retries
fields.description: Backend connection retry count before success or failure. Null on HITs.

fields.name: rid
fields.label: Request ID
fields.description: 8-char random ID generated at this POP. Always set. Use with prid to correlate edge + shield log lines.

fields.name: prid
fields.label: Parent Request ID
fields.description: Edge POP's rid forwarded to the shield. Non-null only on shield log lines (edge=0, cache=MISS).

fields.name: io_input_bytes
fields.label: IO Input Bytes
fields.description: Original image size in bytes before IO processing, from Fastly-Io-Transform-Stats ifsz field.

fields.name: io_output_bytes
fields.label: IO Output Bytes
fields.description: Optimized image size in bytes after IO processing, from Fastly-Io-Transform-Stats ofsz field.

fields.name: io_input_format
fields.label: IO Input Format
fields.description: Original image format before IO processing, from Fastly-Io-Transform-Stats ifmt field.

fields.name: io_output_format
fields.label: IO Output Format
fields.description: Output image format after IO processing, from Fastly-Io-Transform-Stats ofmt field.

fields.name: requests
fields.label: Requests
fields.description: Total number of requests.

fields.name: hit_rate
fields.label: Cache Hit Rate
fields.description: Percentage of requests served from cache (HIT or HIT-STALE).

fields.name: 5xx
fields.label: 5xx Errors
fields.description: Percentage of requests with 5xx status codes.

fields.name: 4xx
fields.label: 4xx Errors
fields.description: Percentage of requests with 4xx status codes.

fields.name: p50_latency
fields.label: P50 Latency
fields.description: Median request processing time (milliseconds).

fields.name: p95_latency
fields.label: P95 Latency
fields.description: 95th percentile request processing time (milliseconds).

fields.name: p99_latency
fields.label: P99 Latency
fields.description: 99th percentile request processing time (milliseconds).

fields.name: throughput
fields.label: Throughput
fields.description: Estimated bandwidth delivered for cache hits (bytes/second).

fields.name: req_size
fields.label: Request Size
fields.description: Median total request size (headers + body).

fields.name: ttfb_ms
fields.label: TTFB
fields.description: Median time to first byte (milliseconds).

fields.name: _bot_name
fields.label: Fastly Bots
fields.description: Virtual field derived from User-Agent and IP to identify known bots.

fields.name: _ngwaf_bot_name
fields.label: NGWAF Verified Bots
fields.description: Virtual field enriched with NGWAF bot signal data.

fields.name: waf_sig_ind
fields.label: NGWAF Signals
fields.description: Individual NGWAF signals extracted from the waf_sig list.

fields.name: edge_score_reason_ind
fields.label: Score Reasons
fields.description: Individual scoring reasons extracted from the comma-separated edge_score_reason field (e.g. 'cookie-missing', 'impossibly-fast', 'robotic-consistency', 'rare-transition'). Lets the dashboard show top-N reason breakdowns and filter by a single reason even when one request triggers multiple.

fields.name: _source_file
fields.label: Source File
fields.description: Original raw log file in Fastly Object Storage.

groups.label: Core Delivery
groups.description: Always-on fields required for basic metrics: error rates, latency, hit rates, throughput.

groups.label: Request Identity
groups.description: Host, URL, HTTP method/version, User-Agent, Referer, request body size, and response Content-Encoding.

groups.label: Cache Deep-Dive
groups.description: TTL, age, hit count, and content digest. Enable for cache pressure analysis.

groups.label: Infrastructure
groups.description: Edge PoP, backend, edge/shield flag, TTFB, TLS version, billing region, IPv6 flag, and connection request count.

groups.label: Geolocation — Basic
groups.description: Country, city, and region. Country alone enables the world map.

groups.label: Geolocation — Precision
groups.description: Latitude, longitude, and US metro code. Requires Basic Geolocation.

groups.label: Network Quality — Core
groups.description: ASN (ISP identity), TCP RTT, and transport protocol.

groups.label: Network Quality — Deep
groups.description: Packet loss, RTT variance/jitter, retransmissions, TCP delivery rate, data segments, and connection type. Requires Network Core.

groups.label: Security: TLS Fingerprinting
groups.description: JA3, JA4, cipher suite fingerprints, and a hashed session-cookie id for botnet grouping, scanner detection, and session-harvesting analysis.

groups.label: Security: Proxy Detection
groups.description: Anonymizing proxy type and provider name (VPN, Tor, DCH).

groups.label: WAF / NGWAF
groups.description: NGWAF fields from the vcl_log-only waf.inspection.* variables. Null/empty if NGWAF is not deployed on this service.
groups.note: All fields are null/empty if NGWAF is not deployed on this service.

groups.label: QUIC / HTTP3
groups.description: QUIC-specific RTT, variance, packet loss, congestion window, and bandwidth estimate. All null for TCP connections.
groups.note: All fields are null for TCP connections. Only useful if your service has meaningful HTTP/3 traffic.

groups.label: Origin Metrics
groups.description: Origin/shield fetch timing, bytes, IP, and retries on cache misses and passes. VCL hooks applied automatically. ottfb/ottlb/oconnect_ms/ost/obytes/oip/oretries are null on HITs; rid is always set; prid set only on shield log lines.
groups.note: Enabling this group deploys additional VCL timing snippets to your service automatically.

groups.label: Image Optimizer Metrics
groups.description: Per-request IO input/output sizes and formats from Fastly-Io-Transform-Stats. Enables actual compression ratio and format conversion analysis.
groups.note: Enabling this group deploys additional VCL snippets to your service. All fields are null for non-IO requests.

groups.label: Aggregate Metrics
groups.description: Computed aggregate metrics used for charts and dashboards.

insights.title: Error Spikes
insights.description: URLs with abnormally elevated 5xx error rates in the window vs. baseline

insights.title: Botnet Grouping
insights.description: TLS fingerprints (JA3/JA4) using far more distinct IPs than their baseline — attackers rotate IPs but rarely change TLS stacks

insights.title: Low and Slow Scans
insights.description: IPs probing many sensitive / vulnerability paths at a deliberately low request rate spread over a long span — designed to evade rate limits

insights.title: Credential Enumeration / Brute Force
insights.description: IPs generating a spike of 401/403 responses on authentication paths (login, auth, OAuth, password reset) — credential stuffing or brute force

insights.title: Content-Discovery Scanning
insights.description: IPs generating a burst of 404s across many distinct URLs — directory / endpoint enumeration probing for hidden or vulnerable paths

insights.title: City Traffic Surges
insights.description: Cities with traffic volumes significantly higher than their historical baseline

insights.title: City Error Spikes
insights.description: Cities experiencing abnormally high error rates compared to their own baseline

insights.title: City Latency Regressions
insights.description: Cities where response times (P95) have significantly slowed down compared to their baseline

insights.title: New City Traffic
insights.description: Cities with zero baseline presence now sending traffic

insights.title: New Country Traffic
insights.description: Countries with zero baseline presence now sending traffic

insights.title: URL Latency Regressions
insights.description: URLs where response times (P95) have significantly slowed down compared to their baseline

insights.title: ASN Concentration
insights.description: ISPs (ASNs) with a disproportionately large share of total traffic compared to the baseline

insights.title: Proxy Traffic Surge
insights.description: Significant increase in traffic from known anonymizing proxies (VPN, Tor, etc.)

insights.title: User-Agent Monoculture
insights.description: A single User-Agent string responsible for a massive percentage of traffic — typical for scraping or DDoS bots

insights.title: Request Size Anomalies
insights.description: Drastic increase in average request body or header size — signal for data exfiltration or buffer overflow attempts

insights.title: Cache TTL Mismatches
insights.description: Objects being served from cache with very low hits and low TTLs — indicates inefficient caching strategy

insights.title: WAF Signal Spikes
insights.description: Abnormal increase in specific NGWAF signals (e.g. SQLi, XSS) across multiple IPs

insights.title: Network Path (ASN) Health
insights.description: ASNs experiencing elevated packet loss, jitter, or TCP retransmissions vs. their baseline

insights.title: Billing Region Latency
insights.description: Fastly regions showing elevated edge latency or TTFB spikes

insights.title: Scripted Traffic Patterns
insights.description: IPs demonstrating highly regular request intervals — automated scrapers, pollers, or cron-scheduled scripts that evade volumetric rate limits

insights.title: Scripted Traffic Patterns (by TLS Fingerprint)
insights.description: TLS fingerprints sending requests on a highly regular cadence — catches IP-rotating scrapers sharing a stable TLS stack

insights.title: New Probe URLs
insights.description: Common attack patterns and sensitive paths appearing for the first time

insights.title: Cipher Fingerprint Clustering
insights.description: TLS cipher suites being used by a suspiciously large and spiking number of distinct IPs

insights.title: Impossible Distance / Spoofing
insights.description: Traffic where the network latency (RTT) is physically too low for the reported client distance

insights.title: Connection Reuse Anomaly
insights.description: IPs making an unusually high number of requests per single TCP connection

insights.title: Origin Latency Spike
insights.description: Sudden and significant increase in P95 response time from the origin server

insights.title: Origin Error Rate
insights.description: Significant increase in 5xx errors returned by the origin server

insights.title: Origin Retries Elevated
insights.description: URLs experiencing frequent retries when fetching from origin, indicating backend instability

insights.title: Specific Origin IP Failing
insights.description: One or more origin IP addresses are returning significantly more errors than their peers

insights.title: Shield Path Degradation
insights.description: Increased latency on the network path between edge POPs and shield POPs

insights.title: Cache Efficiency Collapse
insights.description: URLs whose cacheable hit ratio (HIT/(HIT+MISS)) dropped sharply vs. their baseline

insights.title: Cacheability Regression
insights.description: URLs that flipped from cacheable to mostly PASS (uncacheable) vs. their baseline

insights.title: Tail Latency Anomaly
insights.description: Endpoints where P99 latency is more than 5× higher than P50, indicating major outliers

insights.title: Image Optimization Opportunities
insights.description: Large images being served without modern compression (WebP/AVIF), especially to mobile users

insights.title: ASN/Metro Performance Regressions
insights.description: Specific ISP/Metro combinations showing significantly higher network latency than baseline

insights.title: Referer Monoculture
insights.description: A single Referer driving an outsized, spiking share of total traffic — scraping, hotlinking, or a spoofed-referer flood

insights.title: HTTP Method Drift
insights.description: A write method (POST/PUT/DELETE/…) surging to an outsized share of traffic vs a read-dominated baseline — API abuse or form/credential floods

insights.title: New ASN Traffic
insights.description: An ASN (ISP/datacenter) with zero baseline presence now sending meaningful traffic — a new botnet source, proxy pool, or datacenter range

insights.title: ASN Hosting Shift
insights.description: An ASN's traffic composition shifting from consumer to datacenter/hosting — bot pools or scrapers spinning up on hosting infrastructure

insights.title: Metro Delivery-Rate Degradation
insights.description: US metro areas whose median TCP delivery rate (throughput) collapsed vs. baseline — regional last-mile or peering degradation

insights.title: Connection-Type Mix Shift
insights.description: A client connection type/speed combo (e.g. cellular, datacenter) surging to an outsized share of traffic vs. baseline — a bot pool or routing shift

insights.title: PoP Latency Regression
insights.description: Individual Fastly PoPs (datacenters) whose P95 edge latency regressed sharply vs. baseline — finer-grained than region or city latency

insights.title: HTTP/3 → TCP Fallback Spike
insights.description: A service-wide drop in QUIC (HTTP/3) share vs. baseline — clients failing to sustain QUIC and falling back to TCP (middlebox/UDP throttling)

insights.title: Cache HIT-Ratio Cliff
insights.description: The whole service's edge cache HIT ratio (HIT/(HIT+MISS)) fell off a cliff vs. baseline — a purge storm, TTL change, or origin Cache-Control regression

insights.title: Payload Compression Regression
insights.description: Compressible responses (JS/CSS/HTML/JSON/SVG/XML) that flipped from compressed (gzip/br) to served uncompressed vs. baseline — a broken Accept-Encoding path or origin regression inflating egress and TTFB

insights.title: Session-ID Harvesting
insights.description: A single IP presenting a large, spiking number of distinct session cookies vs. baseline — session-token brute forcing, cookie replay, or credential stuffing that mints a fresh session per attempt

insights.title: Origin Connect vs Read Timeout Split
insights.description: Splits origin slowness into connect (TCP+TLS handshake) vs read (processing to first byte) phases and flags whichever P95 regressed — slow-connect points at origin/LB saturation, slow-read at app/DB processing

insights.title: Bot & Crawler Referral & Bandwidth Disparity
insights.description: Identifies bots, scrapers, and search/AI crawlers consuming high request volume and egress bandwidth while driving negligible human referral traffic back to the platform

insights.title: Stale Headless Browser
insights.description: Detects anomalous clusters of request traffic using stale Chrome major versions, a standard fingerprint for un-updated Puppeteer/Playwright headless bots

insights.title: Orphaned Deep Crawl
insights.description: Flags client IPs performing direct, deep scans of nested catalog/database resource routes with empty HTTP referer headers

insights.title: Residential Fingerprint Dispersion
insights.description: Identifies identical TLS/TCP client handshakes distributed across multiple residential ASNs, signaling rotated botnet scans evading ASN blocks

minimal.label: Minimal
minimal.description: Always-on fields only. Error rates, latency, hit rates, throughput.

standard.label: Standard
standard.description: Recommended for most sites. Request details, infrastructure, basic geo, proxy detection.

security.label: Security
security.description: Standard + TLS fingerprinting and WAF. For security monitoring.

performance.label: Performance
performance.description: Standard + cache deep-dive, network quality core, and origin metrics. For delivery optimization.

streaming.label: Streaming
streaming.description: Standard + precision geo and full network telemetry. For streaming video analysis.

full.label: Full
full.description: All groups enabled. Maximum data collection.
